narration:0:1620875001:0.text: Soon, the plaza quiets down as the feast is about to end...
narration:0:1620875001:0.source_cn: 谈话期间，欢笑声渐渐低去，庆功宴已经临近尾声……

narration:1:1620875002:0.text: You and your companions gather in a secluded corner to share your findings.
narration:1:1620875002:0.source_cn: 你们在僻静的角落汇合，该总结一下调查的收获了
narration:1:1620875002:0.male: You and your companions gather in a secluded corner to share your findings.
narration:1:1620875002:0.female: You and your companions gather in a secluded corner to share your findings.

say:3:1620875003:0.text: Terrence, the guard captain, and his men have been tracking the Hypofiends' activities. He has noticed that their attacks are becoming more frequent.
say:3:1620875003:0.source_cn: 警卫队长泰伦斯一直在安排人手记录魔物的行动数据，他发现...

say:4:1620875004:0.text: He has passed the data to Zandra, the scholar, who concludes that the Hypofiends are likely to launch their largest attack on Hausburg in just two days.
say:4:1620875004:0.source_cn: 他将这些数据提交给了学者赞德拉研究。研究得出的结论是：...

say:5:1620875005:0.text: Which means we only have <style="highlight">two days</style> to get to the bottom of things.
say:5:1620875005:0.source_cn: 所以，这次我们的调查时限只有<style=highli...

say:7:1620875006:0.text: A month ago, Zandra noticed an <style="highlight">unusual magic source</style> in Hausburg, the very thing drawing the Hypofiends to the town.
say:7:1620875006:0.source_cn: 除了这件事之外，一个月前赞德拉还发现豪斯镇内开始出现<...

say:8:1620875007:2.text: That led her to reach out to Terrence, hoping to investigate the magic source and, in the process, strengthen her own mana.
say:8:1620875007:2.source_cn: 于是她与泰伦斯开始合作，希望能解析出这股异常魔法波动的...

say:9:1620875008:0.text: However, recent evidence suggests that the magic source came from outside. The fact that Zandra is an outsider has eroded the trust between her and Terrence.
say:9:1620875008:0.source_cn: 但近期他们发现，很可能是外来者将魔法波动带入豪斯镇的。...

say:10:1620875009:0.text: Also, Zandra suspected that someone was getting in the way of her research, so she asked us to help her out.
say:10:1620875009:0.source_cn: 而且，赞德拉说还有人在暗处中阻挠着她的研究。所以她发出...

say:12:1620875010:0.text: I talked to the weapon guy, Odum, and he seemed really fishy! He might be involved in the plot behind the Hypofiend attacks, but he doesn't know much. Probably just a pawn...
say:12:1620875010:0.source_cn: 那个武器商人奥多姆很可疑，似乎参与到了引发魔物袭击的阴...

say:13:1620875011:0.text: His weapon store wasn't doing well when things were peaceful, but ever since the Hypofiends showed up, his business has been booming!
say:13:1620875011:0.source_cn: 我听说原本豪斯镇生活安稳，奥多姆的武器店都快破产了。但...

say:14:1620875012:0.text: He stands to gain from these attacks, which could explain his motive.
say:14:1620875012:0.source_cn: 所以他希望魔物的数量维持在一个“刚刚好”的范畴。我觉得...

say:15:1620875013:0.text: In his defense, Odum claimed he couldn't have orchestrated such a grand scheme by himself, since he neither wields magic nor knows how to fight.
say:15:1620875013:0.source_cn: 可是……可是奥多姆辩解说，他只是个普通商人，不懂魔法也...

say:17:1620875014:1.text: You relay your conversation with Salome, along with the suspicious things you noticed about her...
say:17:1620875014:1.source_cn: 你向众人分享了与萨洛米的谈话，以及你认为她身上存在的可...
say:17:1620875014:1.male: You relay your conversation with Salome, along with the suspicious things you noticed about her...
say:17:1620875014:1.female: You relay your conversation with Salome, along with the suspicious things you noticed about her...

say:19:1620875015:1.text: Hmm, she's sketchy. As far as I know, the methods to boost mana quickly are all...
say:19:1620875015:1.source_cn: 唔，她很可疑。据我所知，的确存在一些能突破桎梏，强行提...

say:21:1620875016:1.text: I get what you mean. Salome's suspicious, but she's too defensive to cooperate with us right now.
say:21:1620875016:1.source_cn: 嗯……萨洛米身上有很多疑点，但她的抵触情绪实在太严重了...

say:22:1620875017:1.text: Everyone, let's figure out what we can do right now.
say:22:1620875017:1.source_cn: 各位，我们先整理一下现阶段能做的事吧。

say:23:1620875018:1.text: As Pippa said, Odum's very likely just an accomplice...
say:23:1620875018:1.source_cn: 按照皮帕所说，奥多姆可能只想趁机捞点钱，大概率只是帮凶...

say:24:1620875019:1.text: If we play our cards right, he could lead us to the mastermind.
say:24:1620875019:1.source_cn: 他或许能成为一个很好的突破口。顺着这条线，说不定能揪出...

say:25:1620875020:1.text: I'd say we can trust Zandra. She wants the same things we do, and she was the first to offer working together.
say:25:1620875020:1.source_cn: 我认为赞德拉应该是可信的。她和我们的目标一致，也是第一...

say:26:1620875021:1.text: I concur! I believe the <style="highlight">magic source</style> she found holds the truth we're after!
say:26:1620875021:1.source_cn: 嗯，我也这么认为！而且我觉得……她提到的<style=...

choice_prompt:27:1620875021.text: I concur! I believe the <style="highlight">magic source</style> she found holds the truth we're after!
choice_prompt:27:1620875021.source_cn: 嗯，我也这么认为！而且我觉得……她提到的<style=highlight>魔法波动</style>，应该就是我们要调查的真相！

say:28:1620875022:1.text: Magister Merlin's right. With so many leads and so little time, it's more efficient to divide and conquer.
say:28:1620875022:1.source_cn: 梅林大人说得没错，这次线索很多，时间又紧，分头行动是最...
say:28:1620875022:1.male: Magister Merlin's right. With so many leads and so little time, it's more efficient to divide and conquer.
say:28:1620875022:1.female: Magister Merlin's right. With so many leads and so little time, it's more efficient to divide and conquer.

say:29:1620875023:1.source_cn: 我打算去找赞德拉合作，各位……

say:31:1620875025:1.text: Alright, I'll team up with Captain Terrence to investigate Odum.
say:31:1620875025:1.source_cn: 那么，我负责和泰伦斯队长一起调查奥多姆。

say:33:1620875027:1.text: Look, isn't that Salome? Why is she leaving already? The feast isn't even over yet.
say:33:1620875027:1.source_cn: 欸，你们看，那不是萨洛米吗？宴会还没有结束，她怎么就要走了？

choice:27:0:1.text: Let's split up and cover more ground!
choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 看来这次我们得分头行动
